links.outcome: Uncertainty in individual predictions despite high aggregate AUC across survival models
links.effect: Mean AUCs 0.840 to 0.851, yet 26% of test-set patients were assigned to conflicting risk groups depending on the model used.
links.quote: Although the survival models achieved high mean areas under the receiver operating characteristics curve ranging from 0.840 to 0.851, 26% of patients in the test set were assigned to conflicting risk groups depending on the model used, indicating considerable variability in model-predicted prognosis.

unlisted_practices: Quantifying individual-level prediction uncertainty with certainty score and predictive multiplicity metrics
Visual informatics tool showing best-, worst-, and most-likely-case survival scenarios for prognosis communication

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates an uncertainty quantification (UQ) framework and visual informatics tool applied to survival prediction models to quantify model disagreement and communicate confidence for clinical decision-making.

primary.practice: uncertainty quantification and visual informatics for prognostic decision support
